name: web-liquid-clay-phone-mockup-green-blue-brand-logo-post
title: Clay-style phone mockup on a liquid chrome swirl background with green-to-blue gradient brand posts
whatItIs: A silvery liquid-chrome swirl background with a soft matte 'clay' style phone mockup showing a social profile and a green-to-blue gradient post with a hexagon brand logo, flanked by two identical square post previews with numbered corner labels (01, 02, 03).
whatItMeans: Premium and tactile; the clay-render phone against liquid chrome gives a simple brand mockup real material sophistication.
techniques: Render a device in soft matte 'clay' style for a premium feel.
Set the mockup against a liquid chrome swirl for contrast.
Number companion post previews for a clear template set.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D style with soft matte, textureless surfaces.
A glossy, fluid metallic surface effect.
